Query: the measurement system for a magnetic field strength with a data rate of megabit per second uses what unit?
Rationale: The Candidate correctly identifies the query type as a ValueQuery (asking for an attribute of an EntitySet) and models the relationship between the measurement system and the data rate. This omission changes the scope of the query from a specific type of measurement system to any measurement system with the specified data rate.
